rows.label: Limited liability entity tax (LLET) minimum
rows.note: Applies to corporations, LLCs, S corporations and limited partnerships; businesses with total gross receipts or gross profits of $3 million or less pay only this minimum.

source.title: Kentucky Department of Revenue: Corporation Income and Limited Liability Entity Tax

rows.label: Limited liability entity tax (LLET) rates
rows.value: Lesser of 0.095% of Kentucky gross receipts or 0.75% of Kentucky gross profits (above $6 million; sliding scale from $3 million to $6 million)
rows.note: LLET paid above the $175 minimum is credited against Kentucky corporate income tax.

sections.title: Kentucky property tax: state rules

rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: County fiscal courts, school boards and other local taxing districts (library, fire, extension, soil conservation, etc.), plus a state rate
rows.note: Local rate increases above 4% in revenue (House Bill 44 rules) require a public hearing and can be put to a recall vote.
